tasks.title: Author investigation-result dual-doc contract
tasks.description: Create the investigation-result dual-doc contract pair under contracts/. The JSON Schema (investigation-result-schema.json, draft-07) defines: verdict enum (VERIFIED_TRUE | VERIFIED_FALSE | INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE | CONTESTED), a mandatory evidence[] array of {source, ref, quote} objects that must be non-empty for VERIFIED_TRUE and VERIFIED_FALSE verdicts, and schema_version. The companion investigation-result-contract.md documents the verdict axis, citation mapping by source type (web=URL, code=file:line, linear=ticket URL, github=issue/PR URL, notion=page URL/block id), and the INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE propagation rule: if any load-bearing sub-claim returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, the aggregate answer inherits that uncertainty and states it explicitly. All leaf agents and the orchestrator emit this single contract.

A 25-test pytest suite validates all four verdict fixtures plus all rejection cases.

tasks.title: Build investigator orchestrator agent (Opus)
tasks.description: Create agents/investigator.md (Opus tier). The orchestrator decomposes a question into sub-claims, routes each to the correct source leaf agent (investigator-code, -web, -linear, -github, -notion under agents/investigators/), and aggregates the per-leaf investigation-results into a unified top-level investigation-result. The aggregator enforces the propagation rule: if any load-bearing sub-claim returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, the aggregate verdict inherits that uncertainty and states it explicitly — the orchestrator never averages uncertainty away into false confidence. All evidence[] arrays are merged. The agent is callable by humans via the investigate skill and directly by other agents (pr-revise, pr-code-review). Emits a schema-valid investigation-result.

tasks.title: Build answer-composer egress agent
tasks.description: Create agents/egress/answer-composer.md (Sonnet tier). The agent consumes an investigation-result and composes a voice-matched Slack reply routed through the slack-casual voice profile (registered in voice-routing.json; profile content is sourced separately). Citations render inline per distinct verified claim, not as an end-footnote block. Claims that returned INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE render an explicit 'couldn't confirm' tag in place of a citation, never smoothed over. Voice governs style only: answer-composer may state only claims that investigation-result verified and may not add a single unverified sentence to sound natural. Output is copy-only (for manual paste to Slack). The agent lives under agents/egress/, not agents/investigators/, preserving the invariant that everything in agents/investigators/ produces an investigation-result.
